subject: english
question:
Select the option that is similar in meaning to the underlined word in the following sentence.

A good critic should also be a person of great __candour__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"candour"** means the quality of being open and honest; frankness. (ईमानदारी)

 
 
• **Example: **Her **candour** in discussing her past mistakes was admirable.
 
 
 
• **"Honesty"** refers to the quality of being truthful and sincere. (ईमानदारी)
 
 
• **Example: **His **honesty **about the project's challenges earned him respect from his colleagues.
 
 

Therefore, the correct synonym of the underlined word is: '**honesty**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Will** (इच्छाशक्ति): The mental power by which one controls their actions and decisions.

 
 
• **Example:** With sheer** will**, he overcame all obstacles in his path.
 
 
 
• **Resolution** (संकल्प): A firm decision to do or not to do something.
 
 
• **Example: **Her** resolution** to quit smoking was unwavering.
 
 
 
• **Power** (शक्ति): The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way.
 
 
• **Example:** The **power **of the storm was evident in the damage it caused.

The correct answer is Option 1)</stro
